description: This file contains helper functions used for mathematical calculations in the PhpSpreadsheet library, including validation and utility functions related to numbers, such as handling small denominators, checking numeric values, and returning special values like NaN or division errors.

classes.name: Helpers
classes.description: A utility class providing static helper methods for mathematical calculations and validation within the PhpSpreadsheet library.

methods.name: verySmallDenominator
methods.description: Returns the quotient of two numbers, or a Division by Zero error if the denominator is too small to avoid numerical instability.

methods.name: validateNumericNullBool
methods.description: Validates and converts a value to a numeric type, treating null and boolean values appropriately, or throws an error.

methods.name: validateNumericNullSubstitution
methods.description: Validates a value as numeric, substituting a provided value if null.

methods.name: validateNotNegative
methods.description: Checks that the number is greater than or equal to zero; throws an error otherwise.

methods.name: validatePositive
methods.description: Checks that the number is greater than zero; throws an error otherwise.

methods.name: validateNotZero
methods.description: Ensures the number is not zero; throws a division error if zero.

methods.name: returnSign
methods.description: Returns 1 if the number is positive, -1 if negative, or 0 if zero.

methods.name: getEven
methods.description: Rounds the number up to the nearest even multiple based on its sign.

methods.name: numberOrNan
methods.description: Returns the number if it's not NaN, otherwise returns the NaN error.
